author: GamingBolt
description:
Trails In The Sky Second Chapter is finally here, but is it worth the year-long wait to finally resolve things with Estelle and Joshua? We dove into it without a moment’s hesitation, and the good news is that we’re glad it delivers. 

This one’s a charming take that’s full of hope that’s sold very well by an endearing cast of characters. They can get pretty nasty when any of the game’s many enemies and bosses show up, though, although the combat does come with a few things to keep in mind before you dive into this one.

We’ve laid it all out in our review, and you’re definitely going to want to see if this one’s lived up to the expectations it came with.
title: Trails In The Sky 2nd Chapter Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Most modern games fail to truly replicate this level of enjoyment, though this isn't to say that WARDOGS is perfect. Balance remains an ever-frail subject, but it's clear that some weapons are far outperforming others. 

Hit registration is also problematic at times, and this is still a military shooter at heart. If you're not used to that methodical style of play, then it can feel like little more than live, die, repeat (with the bonus of going further into debt).
title: WARDOGS - Why Are Millions of GAMERS Addicted?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is only a few weeks away, launching on October 6th for Xbox Series X/S and PC, though Premium Edition owners can start five days earlier on October 1st. It's a cathartic moment for series fans - not just because this is the first new entry since 2019's Gears 5, but because The Coalition is returning to what originally defined the series: Urban warfare, ruined beauty, horror, and a sense of insurmountable odds.

Also, Marcus and Dom are back in the leading roles (alongside newcomers Mags and Lucas). Despite this familiarity, the development team has put in a lot of work to overhaul the experience as we know it while ensuring that everything we know and love - chainsaw bayonets and all - is intact.
title: Gears of War E-Day - 14 NEW Details You Need To Know Before You Buy
